lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，寒冰裂隙中闪现身影。
lines.en: Sibilant, icy fissures reveal its form.

lines.zh: 冰晶在黑暗中闪烁，如恶魔的眼。
lines.en: Icy crystals glimmer in the dark, like demon eyes.

lines.zh: 冰霜之魂在寒风中缭绕，如幽灵。
lines.en: Frost souls swirl in the cold wind, like ghosts.

lines.zh: 冰刃划破黑暗，猎食者降临。
lines.en: Ice blades slice through the darkness, the hunter arrives.

lines.zh: 冰封之爪在寒夜中掠过。
lines.en: Frozen claws skitter across the cold night.
Frozen breath forms icy blades.

lines.zh: 冰刺之魂在黑暗中游走。
lines.en: Frost souls wander in the darkness.
Frozen chains wrap around its limbs.
Icicles glimmer in moonlight.

lines.zh: 冰霜之气在夜空中缭绕。
lines.en: Frost hangs in the night air

lines.zh: 踏碎薄冰，碎片四散坠落。
lines.en: Thin ice shatters underfoot, shards raining down.

lines.zh: 身影在浮岛边缘一闪而过。
lines.en: Its shape flits past the edge of a floating island.

lines.zh: 凝视着远处的光芒，如同猎物。
lines.en: Staring at distant light, like prey.

lines.zh: 寒冰覆盖的鳞片在月光下泛光。
lines.en: Frosty scales gleam in moonlight.
Icicles drip with frost.
Icicles swaying in the cold wind.
Frost souls linger around.
Light flickers in icy fissures.
Cold eyes stare at you.
Icy crystals sway in the cold wind.
Icicles like icy winds.
Cold breath from frozen mouth
Staring at you, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 寒风中，它的眼睛闪烁着威胁。
lines.en: Its eyes flash threats in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 冰刺尖端对着你，威胁的预兆。
lines.en: Icicles point at you, a threat.

lines.zh: 空岛的风把我托在你面前。
lines.en: The sky-island wind sets me before you.

lines.zh: 寒冰裂缝，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Icy fissures, waiting for an opportunity.
It stares at you, frost forming.

lines.zh: 寒光从它的眼睛中射出。
lines.en: Cold light shoots from its eyes.
Icicles point like daggers at you.
Its gaze like a blade in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 凝视着你，寒冰冻结四周。
lines.en: Staring at you, frost freezes around.
The frost edge rings in the wound.
Frost pierces my flesh.
Chill runs through my body.
I am encased in ice.
Cold seeps through my bones.
My claws are frozen.
I am frozen in place.
Ice corrodes my flesh.
Cold wind penetrates my shell.
I am consumed by cold.
Sssss, tasty prey!
Come here, enjoy my ice spines!

lines.zh: 在这片冰刺空岛，寒冷就是我的牙。
lines.en: On these frozen islands, cold is my fang.
Ice Soul will join me soon!
Your flesh is so delicious!
Seek warmth in the cold...
Power lies beneath the ice!
Your end is here!
Ice spines pierce your soul!
Devour your existence...

lines.zh: 冰刺碰撞，撕裂你的防御！
lines.en: Ice spines collide, tear through your defenses!

lines.zh: 冲击你的肉体，冻结你的灵魂！
lines.en: Impact your flesh, freeze your soul!
Release the power of ice in collision!
Ice spines entwine, freeze all!
Power converges, ice spines pierce!
Cold collision, destroy all!
Ice spines interlock, nothing can resist!

lines.zh: 冰刺交织，冻结你的世界！
lines.en: Ice spines entwine, freeze your world!

lines.zh: 冰冷碰撞，撕裂你的防线！
lines.en: Cold collision, tear through your defenses!

lines.zh: 冰刺交织，终结一切对抗！
lines.en: Ice spines entwine, end all resistance!

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，共同繁衍！
lines.en: Find my mate, procreate together!
Life in the cold!
Ice kiss, pass the power!
Share the cold with me!
Ice spines merge, evolve together!
Find eternity in the cold!
Life in the ice never ends!
Ice spines cross, create life!
Find soulmate in the cold!
Love endures in the ice!
Icicle Souls shine with cold light.
Icicle Souls freeze the air.

lines.zh: 恶魔的冰刺之魂闪烁着。
lines.en: The Fiend's Icicle Soul glows.

lines.zh: 这冰刺之魂，冰冷又致命。
lines.en: This Icicle Soul is cold and deadly.

lines.zh: 你感受到恶魔的灵魂了吗？
lines.en: Feel the fiend's soul?
Icicle Soul, cruel and cold.
Icicle Soul, chilling.

lines.zh: 恶魔的灵魂，冰冷而强大。
lines.en: The fiend's soul, cold and powerful.

lines.zh: 冰刺之魂，你感受到了吗？
lines.en: Icicle Soul, do you feel it?
Icicle Soul, the fiend's legacy.

lines.zh: 空岛的风，把它的味道送来。
lines.en: Sky-island wind carries its scent to me.
I'll feast on you.

lines.zh: 冰刺的空岛，风把我托着。
lines.en: The icy isles hold my weight on wind.
Prey, my food.
Ice Spire Island prey.

lines.zh: 冰刺空岛的猎物，我的猎物。
lines.en: Ice Spire Island prey, my prey.
My next prey.
Ice Spire Island prey, mine.
Ice Spire Island, prey everywhere.

lines.zh: 冰刺空岛的风，把你吹来了。
lines.en: The sky-island wind blew you to me.

lines.zh: 浮岛之间的桥上，它停住了。
lines.en: On the bridge between islands, it halts.

lines.zh: 寒风里多了一股活人的热气。
lines.en: A living warmth enters the freezing wind.

lines.zh: 冰锥从云里垂下来，指向你。
lines.en: An icicle drops from the clouds, pointing at you.

lines.zh: 它在碎冰上嗅出了血味。
lines.en: It smells blood on the broken ice.

lines.zh: 远处的人影，被它看见了。
lines.en: It has seen the figure in the distance.
The ice-spike islands have a new visitor.

lines.zh: 冰刺空岛的风，就是我的呼吸。
lines.en: The wind of the ice islands is my breath.
Icicles will pierce you.
Prey, your end.
Icicles will freeze you.

lines.zh: 你的死亡将由冰刺决定。
lines.en: Your death will be by icicles.
Prey, my target.
Icicles will end you.
Prey, my prey.
Icicles will destroy you.
Icicles will end your life.
Frost forms under your feet first.

lines.zh: 它踩过的地方，冰缝在扩大。
lines.en: The cracks widen where it steps.

lines.zh: 冰棱一根根竖起，围成圈。
lines.en: Icicles rise one by one into a ring.
It raises a hand and the air turns white.
Don't stop. Stopping means freezing.

lines.zh: 它的爪印在冰面上发着蓝光。
lines.en: Its prints glow blue on the ice.
Snowflakes drift toward you against the wind.

lines.zh: 它绕着你走，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: It circles you, each loop closer.

lines.zh: 呼吸在它口边凝成尖刺。
lines.en: Its breath hardens into spikes at its lips.
You wait for it to move. It waits too.
Freeze all!
Frozen venom!
Chilling winds!
Kiss of frost!
Ice spikes through!
Frost strike!
Frost magic!

lines.zh: 空岛的风，把我的爪磨得更冷。
lines.en: The sky-island wind sharpens my claws colder.
Cold strike!

lines.zh: 一掌拍下，冰面裂成蛛网。
lines.en: One slam and the ice cracks like a web.
An ice spike stabs from behind you.

lines.zh: 它的爪子冻住了你的手臂。
lines.en: Its claws freeze your arm stiff.

lines.zh: 寒气钻进伤口，麻得发木。
lines.en: Cold seeps into the wound and numbs it.

lines.zh: 它拽住你的衣角，往崖边拖。
lines.en: It grabs your hem and drags you toward the cliff.

lines.zh: 一脚踹出，你滑出好几格。
lines.en: A kick sends you sliding several blocks.

lines.zh: 冰刺横扫，划开一道白痕。
lines.en: An ice spike sweeps past, leaving a white line.
It pins you to the frozen ground.

lines.zh: 你的血滴在冰上，立刻凝住。
lines.en: Your blood hits the ice and freezes at once.

lines.zh: 寒风灌进嘴里，喊不出声。
lines.en: Freezing wind fills your mouth; no sound comes out.
It tears off a chunk of ice and hurls it.
Son of ice!
Born of frost!
Ice hell!

lines.zh: 冰刺岛上，我从雪里站起来。
lines.en: On the ice-spike isle I rise from snow.
Freezing land!
Ice Spike Isle!
Frozen tundra!
Frost palace!
Frozen world!
Snowy night walker!

lines.zh: 浮岛边缘凝出一具冰身。
lines.en: An icy body condenses at the island's edge.

lines.zh: 雪堆塌下去，露出它的轮廓。
lines.en: A snowdrift collapses, revealing its outline.
Flames burn my flesh.
The fall left me hurt.
Ice turned to water down my throat.
The blast tore the ice spikes and split me.
An ice arrow pierced my heart.
Magic froze my veins.
Hunger weakened my strength.

lines.zh: 雷电击中了我，冰刺空岛都晃了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me; the icy isles shook.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我连影子都没了。
lines.en: In the void I have no shadow left.
